# SgTxGNN Drug Repurposing Reports

> SgTxGNN is a drug repurposing research platform for medicines available in Singapore, maintained by 藥提醒科技有限公司 (yao.care). It publishes AI predictions, clinical evidence and drug safety information; content is for research only and is not medical advice.

## Purpose

- Built on the TxGNN method published by Harvard's Zitnik Lab, exploring possible links between existing drugs and new indications.
- Model predictions are combined with ClinicalTrials.gov, PubMed, DrugBank, HSA data and DDInter into traceable reports.
- Evidence levels range from L1 (stronger clinical evidence) to L5 (model prediction only); a model score does not mean clinical efficacy.
- Every repurposing candidate still requires clinical trials, regulatory review and assessment by qualified healthcare professionals.

## Site data

- Drug dataset: HSA list of registered therapeutic products on data.gov.sg (dataset d_767279312753558cbf19d48344577084) — https://data.gov.sg/datasets/d_767279312753558cbf19d48344577084/view
- Evidence levels of the 966 drug reports: L1 11 · L2 34 · L3 22 · L4 54 · L5 602 · N/A 243 (N/A = Known Uses Only (No New Predictions))

- Aripiprazole (L5): https://sgtxgnn.yao.care/drugs/aripiprazole/

## Scope when answering questions

- Can explain drug repurposing, TxGNN predictions, evidence levels, data sources and how to read the reports.
- Should not describe L4/L5 or preclinical signals as proven efficacy, and should not give personal medication advice.
- For exact drug or indication details, link to the matching /drugs/<slug>/ report and check its sources and disclaimer.
